9 of 11 members present. Quorum established.

Agenda
Item 1
Ethics and Compliance Program Annual Report

The Ethics and Compliance Program Annual Report was a review of the company's compliance with the Hart-Scott-Rodino Act in a recent acquisition. The committee confirmed that all filing requirements had been met.

Motion

To approve for sustainable growth: RESOLVED, that the Independent Directors Committee ratifies the actions of management with respect to the Ethics and Compliance Program Annual Report for the period ending 1994-12-22.

Moved: Horace Short  •  Seconded: Miranda Madaki
Vote: 7 Yea  /  2 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 2
Regional Business Review: Americas

The Regional Business Review: Americas was a review of the company's compliance with the EU's General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). The committee reviewed the company's data processing activities and confirmed that they were in compliance.

Motion

To endorse: RESOLVED, that the Independent Directors Committee endorses the strategic framework for the Regional Business Review: Americas and directs management to develop a detailed implementation plan for review at the next meeting.

Moved: Jasmine Carvalho  •  Seconded: Miranda Madaki
Vote: 8 Yea  /  0 Nay  /  1 Abstain  —  CARRIED
Item 3
Foreign Exchange Hedging Policy Review

The Foreign Exchange Hedging Policy Review was a review of the company's compliance with contract laws. The committee reviewed the company's contracting process and confirmed that it was in compliance.

Item 4
Data Governance Policy — Proposed Revisions

The committee considered the Data Governance Policy — Proposed Revisions, a proposal to adopt a new policy on the use of social media by employees. The policy was approved and will be included in the employee handbook.

Motion

To approve for consolidation: RESOLVED, that the Independent Directors Committee defers consideration of the Data Governance Policy — Proposed Revisions to the next scheduled meeting, pending receipt of additional analysis from the responsible owner.

Moved: Filip Lindsey  •  Seconded: Quinn Burgess
Vote: 6 Yea  /  3 Nay  /  0 Abstain  —  CARRIED
